MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS
MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS
[C. M L. A's]
(Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th duly 1977)
No. 1
Strikes, agitation or political activity of any kind in
Educational Institutions is prohibited. Maximum punishment 5 years Rigorous
Imprisonment and/or whipping not exceeding 5 stripes.
